mapper.sql: (SELECT FROM t_payment_order p WHERE p.payment_order_id = ppl.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(ppl.payment_order_id) AND CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(ppl.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1) AS successFactIssue

if.test: query.processStage != null and query.processStage != '' and query.processStage != '全部'
query.logLevel != null and query.logLevel != '' and query.logLevel != '全部'

mapper.sql: log_no AS logNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, order_no AS orderNo, process_stage AS processStage, log_level AS logLevel, log_level_type AS logLevelType, message, source, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
mapper.select:
SELECT ppl.log_no AS logNo, ppl.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, ppl.order_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, ppl.request_no AS requestNo, ppl.source_type AS sourceType, ppl.source_no AS sourceNo, ppl.process_stage AS processStage, ppl.log_level AS logLevel, ppl.log_level_type AS logLevelType, ppl.message, ppl.source, DATE_FORMAT(ppl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,
FROM t_payment_process_log ppl LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = ppl.order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(standard_order.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(ppl.order_no) AND CAST(standard_order.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(ppl.order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_prepay_order owned_pr WHERE owned_pr.payment_order_id = ppl.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(owned_pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(ppl.payment_order_id) AND CAST(owned_pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(ppl.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) AND owned_pr.order_no = ppl.order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(owned_pr.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(ppl.order_no) AND CAST(owned_pr.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(ppl.order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND owned_pr.source_kind = 'STANDARD_ORDER' AND CHAR_LENGTH(owned_pr.source_kind) = CHAR_LENGTH('STANDARD_ORDER') AND CAST(owned_pr.source_kind AS BINARY(16)) = CAST('STANDARD_ORDER' AS BINARY(16))) WHERE ppl.log_no = #{logNo} AND CHAR_LENGTH(ppl.log_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{logNo}) AND CAST(ppl.log_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{logNo} AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalLogCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN log_level = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS errorLogCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN log_level = 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS warnLogCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN log_level = 'INFO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS infoLogCount, COUNT(DISTINCT process_stage) AS distinctStageCount, COUNT(DISTINCT source) AS distinctSourceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN process_stage = '渠道回调' AND log_level = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS callbackErrorCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN process_stage = '业务事件' AND log_level = 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS eventWarnCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN message LIKE '%回调%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS callbackKeywordCount, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(created_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestLogAt FROM t_payment_process_log
